title.en: The per-meal nutrients a MENU message carries and the packs read

goal.en: MENU carries energy, sodium, fruit and vegetables and protein per meal. The school-meals and sodium-reduction packs compare these fields with their limits; the sodium pack validates as a profile document.

note.en: Energy, sodium and fruit-and-vegetable grams become energyKcal, sodiumMg and fruitVegG.
Protein becomes proteinG; a message may carry any subset.
A MENU with no nutrient is a usage error.
A nutrient word without a number is a usage error.
The sodium-reduction rule pack is itself a profile document.

cli: cookwala sms "MENU D12 KCAL650 SODIUM540 FV95"

outcome.en: You know the four nutrient fields and their names in documents. Next: scenario 077 hashes and validates the rule packs.
